title: NAFEMS LE10 thick plate under pressure (hex20)
source: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3, October 1990, test LE10 (target σ_yy = −5.38 MPa at D); as reproduced in the Abaqus 2017 Benchmarks Guide, 'LE10: Thick plate under pressure'

quantities.quantity: σ_yy at D (2, 0, 0.3) on the loaded face
quantities.reason: the target is published to three figures; at D the stress is extrapolated to a corner where the hole edge meets the loaded face, and published converged solutions scatter by 1–2% (Abaqus Benchmarks Guide fine meshes: −5.51 to −5.89)
